meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo on Codex. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo UserPromptSubmit hook injects a short bootstrap that points at this file. Read the whole file and follow every rule in it for the rest of the task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让助手进入受规则约束的工作模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要助手在长任务中严格执行预设规则
copy.tagline_en: Make the agent follow a strict set of rules for the rest of the task
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to enforce a rigid workflow on long, demanding AI interactions

howto.what: 进入 ultrawork 模式后,Claude 会先声明一句固定话,再按严格流程干活:先写失败测试再实现、用真实界面(浏览器、curl 等)验证、把计划和证据记入一个记事本文件,并给每步建清单。它追求真能用,而不只是测试通过。
howto.when: 当你的说法里出现 ultrawork 或 ulw 这两个触发词时,该技能会自动启动,接管后续任务处理。

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式修这个 bug:先写失败测试,再实现。
say.note: 进入模式,按 RED→GREEN 流程执行。

say.text: 开 ulw,按 HEAVY 流程做,完成后用真实页面验证。
say.note: 涉及敏感改动时会采用更严格的验证。

say.text: ultrawork 模式重构这段代码,每步都要记录到记事本。
say.note: 会在记事本里追加计划、发现和证据。

howto.what_en: In ultrawork mode Claude prints a fixed declaration, writes failing tests before code, verifies via real surfaces (browser/curl), logs into a notepad, and tracks steps. It targets end-to-end proven results, not just green tests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user's prompt contains 'ultrawork' or 'ulw' — the omo UserPromptSubmit hook injects a bootstrap pointing to this file, and Claude takes over the rest of the task per its rules.

say_en.text: Fix this bug in ultrawork mode: failing test first, then implement.
say_en.note: Enters the mode and runs the RED→GREEN flow.

say_en.text: Start ulw, use the HEAVY process, verify on the real page.
Ultrawork mode: refactor this code, log every step in the notepad.
